MRI machines use a powerful magnetic field—up to hundreds of thousands of times stronger than Earth’s magnetism—so metal objects can be violently attracted. In 2023 São Paulo, a man brought his mother for an MRI scan but didn’t inform staff he was carrying a pistol. When the machine started, the firearm was ripped from his waistband and discharged, injuring him in the abdomen. What other medical safety rules should we cover next?
